name: STIL centriolar assembly protein

function.text: STIL encodes SCL-interrupting locus protein. It participates in centrosome duplication and forebrain development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal recessive primary microcephaly (autosomal recessive); microcephaly 7, primary, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
